mechanics.title: Recursive opening
mechanics.description: Connected door-type blocks open together up to a configurable distance (default 10, max 32). Crouching opens only the single block.

mechanics.title: Enabled types
mechanics.description: By default only doors are enabled; fence gates and trapdoors are off by default in the config.

getting_started: Click one half of a double door; the other opens too. Sneak to open a single one.
editor_notes: The pack does not override defaults per config-overrides, so trapdoors and fence gates likely do not open as pairs; verify in-game. Mod edits configs of other double-door mods to avoid double-triggering.
name: Double Doors
summary: Matching double doors open and close together with one click, button or pressure plate. Connected door-type blocks are opened recursively, and villagers can use double doors.
